summary: Preserved candidate PR 1583 through exact commit bd84efaef10c01b4354e5ceed7b69a6c247d9ec5 and corrected Mistral canonical-array streaming to accept every JSON-valid whitespace choice after object-separator commas. The independently reviewed no-space array failed for whole, character, and all 124 two-way split deliveries before the correction and passed all of them afterward without leaking tool JSON into normal_text.

tests.command: detached bd84efaef10c01b4354e5ceed7b69a6c247d9ec5; PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-98a81bb7870a/venv/bin/python -c '<independent Mistral no-space counterexample>'
tests.what_was_measured: Diagnostic driver confirmed one-shot returned three calls while whole and character streaming returned only call 0, leaked the remaining JSON as normal_text, and all 124 two-way splits failed parity. The driver itself completed normally; candidate-before.txt records the mismatch.
After correction, whole and character streaming returned all three calls, normal_text was empty, and 0 of 124 two-way splits failed.
29 tests passed with 2,077 subtests, including separator whitespace variants empty, space, tab, and newline under whole, character, and every two-way split delivery.
Complete function-call unit suite: 551 tests passed with 2,098 subtests.

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and correction are deterministic Python string/JSON parser behavior. No GPU kernel or model execution is involved.

remaining_limitations: No model weights, tokenizer vocabulary, HTTP serving process, semantic model accuracy, GPU kernel, multi-GPU, or distributed workload was exercised.
The prepared environment is ROCm 7.2/gfx950 rather than the reporter's CUDA/RTX 4090 environment; no cross-architecture serving claim is made.
This correction validates syntax accepted by Mistral detect_and_parse and parser chunk-boundary parity, not a particular model's likelihood of emitting each JSON whitespace form.
